abstract: Production skill for cost-efficient Exa (exa.ai) use. Routes each job to the cheapest adequate endpoint and setting, overrides costly defaults (auto search type, full-text contents, uncapped metered Agent runs), prices requests offline with a cost script whose tests use live-billed amounts, and documents the 2026-10-27 pricing, limits, free tier, per-key budgets, Agent cancel semantics, contact and Connect surcharges, and monitor billing.
